scope: Bounded official Pécs website review for exact source-name use and city identity only. Ledger includes all 67 source names; searches prioritize the 13 names absent from the narrow archived OSM-place-node cohort. This is separate from the full original-PBF and KSH name audits.

method.nameNormalization: NFKC, Unicode casefold, retain all alphanumeric code points, accents and complete name words/numerals; discard punctuation and whitespace only. No fuzzy match, prefix stripping, substring-only facility match, nearest point or implicit semantic alias.
method.datedCurrentEvidence: Explicit 2026 publication/event or administrative date in opened body plus exact full locality name use and Pécs identity; ©2026 footer, 2026 upload directory or web crawl date are insufficient.
method.roleSeparation: Locality/service-area use, street route use, facility name, address entry, historical locality list and historical broad alias are recorded separately. Exact locality-use support is not a claim of official quarter status.
method.webAccess: read-only search/open connector, no shell network
method.recordFingerprint: SHA256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon, excluding that recordContentSha256 field.
